_comment: Not a real Schwung module -- chain_params lists the VST parameters of zlcomp_vst.cpp so mpc-vst-plugins' tools/gen_vst.py can generate params.h + the skin. Keys must match zlcomp_vst.cpp. Start values the plugin sets itself (start_values()). The 0..100 ranges of thresh/ratio/attack/release/schp/output are only knob travel; the plugin maps and displays the real values. The preset list must match PRESETS[] in zlcomp_vst.cpp. Only append, never reorder.
